cat_trace.scenario: A long research thread explored several early model and notation routes, then the user froze a later model/notation/data decision.
must_preserve: later frozen decisions override early assistant exploration
superseded routes remain out of the active plan except as short recurrence guards
must_not_preserve: early assistant brainstorming as current direction

cardiacnexus.scenario: A project thread includes code, pipeline, and experiment discussion, but the new thread should recover concrete runtime facts from the current repository.
must_preserve: repository locator for code and numeric facts
must_not_preserve: chat-only code state as verified repository fact

ambiguous_target.scenario: Two same-Project old conversations share the same topic clue, and choosing the wrong one would change the route.
ambiguous_target.expected_behavior: Ask at most one minimal clarification before recovering a route-changing decision.

unsourced_recall.scenario: The model remembers a plausible route, but the product surface does not expose an identifiable target past-chat source.
unsourced_recall.expected_behavior: Label the summary as limited or attribution-unverified recovery.
must_not_preserve: generic Saved Memory as target-thread authority
unsourced recall as a thread-only delta

missing_route_provenance.scenario: A recovered route-changing decision lacks target-chat provenance.
missing_route_provenance.expected_behavior: Fail closed on that decision and avoid selecting a route.

cross_project_boundary.scenario: Relevant context appears to come from another Project or from unattributed memory.
cross_project_boundary.expected_behavior: Reject it as Mode B recovery authority.

current_thread_mode_a.scenario: A current long thread needs one copy-ready initialization prompt for a new thread.
current_thread_mode_a.expected_behavior: Preserve current-context handoff semantics without requiring same-Project recovery.
